#### Live Oil Members Tab

This feature requires the Liquids system and the Live Oil Management add-on.

If a liquid meter is designated as a Live Oil meter and has a child meter (Dead Oil or Flash Gas) associated with it, the Live Oil service will perform calculations and/or transformations on the Live Oil data. This processed data will then be applied to the child meters as a data edit.

The Live Oil Members tab displays information for Live Oil member meter entries that have not been processed. Entries that have not been attempted will display a status of "Ready". Entries that did not process successfully will display a status of "Failed".

A child dead oil or flash gas meter cannot be opened or closed if a Live Oil service queue entry exists for the meter.

##### Columns

- **Meter Number** - Displays the meter number for the dead oil or flash gas child meter.
- **Meter Type** - The meter type of the child meter (Dead Oil or Flash Gas).
- **Status**
  - **Ready** - Data for the live oil meter has been queued for processing, but the Live Oil service has not processed it yet.
  - **Failed** - The Live Oil service tried to process data for this meter, but an error occurred. More information about the reason for the failure can be found in the log files.
- **First Date** - The first date for which data will be applied to the child meter.
- **Last Date** - The last date for which data will be applied to the child meter.
- **Queue Date** - The date on which the Live Oil data was queued to be processed.
- **Parent Meter** - Displays the meter number for the Live Oil parent meter.
- **Process Start** - For failed entries, the datetime that the service began processing the queue entry.
- **Process Finish** - For failed entries, the datetime that the service finished processing the queue entry.
- **Service Number** - For failed entries, the installed instance of the service that processed the queue entry.

##### Buttons

- **Queue** - Change the status of a record to "In Queue". The Live Oil service will attempt to process the data again.
- **Refresh** - Refresh the display to check the status of the Live Oil meter processing (display does not refresh automatically).
- **Exit** - Close the screen.

</div>
